sn22.35:1.3: The idea of a “retreat” as understood today was popularized in the 20th century. In early times, it seems, when an individual monastic felt they were ready, they would approach the teacher seeking advice for their retreat.
sn22.35:1.5: _Saṅkhā_ is a calculation or measurement or “reckoning”. The idea is that we define and limit ourselves by our attachments.
